settings.text: Let's face it - our bathrooms are a breeding ground for nasty germs… But worry no more! The UMMA Diamond’s patented UV-C cleansing base station provides a dentist-grade level of sanitization that kills 99.9% of harmful bacteria – including human coronavirus. It's like having a personal bodyguard for your toothbrush!
